[SWS_CRYPT_02109] error handling during unwrap
⌈
The interfaces
SymmetricKeyWrapperCtx::UnwrapSeed and SymmetricKeyWrapperCtx::-
UnwrapKey shall
• return a CryptoErrorDomain::kInvalidInputSize error, if the length of
the provided ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRegion is unsupported by the al-
gorithm specified during context creation. • return a CryptoErrorDomain::kUninitializedContext error, if Symmet-
ricKeyWrapperCtx::SetKey was never called.
• return a CryptoErrorDomain::kUsageViolation error, if the kAllowKey-
Importing flag of the ara::crypto::AllowedUsageFlags is not set for the
SymmetricKey specified in the SetKey call.
⌋
